### Laureate Education Announces Date of Second Quarter 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call


July 1, 2025


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/323177153/files/doc_news/Laureate-Education-Announces-Date-of-Second-Quarter-2025-Earnings-Release-and-Conference-Call-2025.pdf)


MIAMI, July 01, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Laureate Education, Inc. (NASDAQ: LAUR) plans to release results for the quarter ended June 30, 2025, on Thursday, July 31, 2025, before the stock market opens. Following the release, the Company will host a conference call with investors and analysts at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss the first quarter results and the Company's business outlook.


Interested parties are invited to listen to the earnings conference call by[registering here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Yj-SjrZfDtR0Xl8Lx-rEXSU7ZZX5PSrjIqk4t2P2fF_I0EuLsYmOAWESYj1kQyLvYpEbhal7zp4FKUo-ux2Vh92AVhRw9LNWztmAxOppZltMPje6Q3LQWHXpZqll0jccHUkdH0a0W2e-u0lMXs602XcGhzrEAixYcTUlmrMzqiU=) to receive dial in information.


The webcast of the conference call, including replays, and a copy of the earnings release and the related slides will be made available through the Investor Relations section of the Company's website at[www.laureate.net](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=OueOv0o5PUlZMUleK8v9fq2sEOaJRvHRgMd8Og9yvSpHnr5kxo7-uHn_iC7lPT1MZjD3uqGkGVvfoB1Hu7peUShmxRm7k5TiDqcEPRVC6EU=) .


***About Laureate Education, Inc.***


Laureate Education, Inc. operates five higher education institutions across Mexico and Peru, enrolling more than 470,000 students in high-quality undergraduate, graduate, and specialized degree programs through campus-based and online learning. Our universities have a deep commitment to academic quality and innovation, strive for market-leading employability outcomes, and work to make higher education more accessible. At Laureate, we know that when our students succeed, countries prosper, and societies benefit.
